mcp.description: Query a reference database covering the Star Trek franchise: every TV series, episode, and movie, plus their home-media (DVD/Blu-ray) releases. Use read_records or aggregate_records against Series, Episode, and Movie for most questions; join across series_id / media_set_id / medium_volume_id / episode_id to answer questions about releases.

Series.description: Star Trek television series, one row per show, with the date each first and last aired.

Episode.description: Individual episodes across every Star Trek series. series_id links to Series. Includes air date, remastered air date, season, episode number, production code, and stardate.

Movie.description: The Star Trek feature films, with theatrical release date and stardate. Not linked to Series.

MediaSet.description: A home-media release set (e.g. 'DVD', 'Blu-ray', 'HD DVD') for one series and season. series_id links to Series.

MediumVolume.description: A single disc within a MediaSet. media_set_id links to MediaSet; sequence is the disc number within the set.

MediumVolumeEpisode.description: Join table linking a MediumVolume (disc) to the episodes it contains, via medium_volume_id and episode_id.
